refractionRecipe.usage: Shared card recipe used by Demo scenario entries, Portal content cards, component specimens and application/page/starting-point templates; material.js applies semantic card routing and optical-glass.js mounts optics. Dense SolidPlate content and material comparison specimens retain their own roles.
refractionRecipe.optics: A rounded-rectangle signed distance field generates one Canvas RG normal map for one SVG feDisplacementMap on the backdrop; static Gaussian frost; radius follows computed card geometry; neutral low-opacity plate; default public strength 180, adjustable 0-300; foreground content remains unfiltered
refractionRecipe.api: window.GaryGlassSurface exposes mount(element), setStrength(value), strength getter and destroy(element); mounted cards use data-gary-refraction-state=svg with --gary-refraction-filter and an owned hidden .gary-refraction-filter SVG
refractionRecipe.fallback: Non-Chromium or unsupported rendering, glass=fallback and glass=frosted use data-gary-refraction-state=fallback and preserve the existing CSS frosted material
refractionRecipe.motion: Static optics follows the real backdrop without independent animation; reduced motion retains the complete static treatment; refractive surfaces suppress card contour fields and edge orbit
refractionRecipe.lifecycle: Automatically mount existing and dynamically inserted matching cards, regenerate the normal map on resize, and release owned filters and state when cards are removed or destroyed; no network dependencies
refractionRecipe.baseline: Preserve approved geometry, typography, source links, keyboard behavior and all other card styles

interactionRecipe.compositionReference: COSMOS local mirror: calm center, generous separation, light display type, content-led media stages; no copied assets
interactionRecipe.base: neutral translucent plate, 12px backdrop blur, Gary 30px radius; dark and light share one recipe
interactionRecipe.action: Only real links/buttons use data-gary-card=action: pointer glow, isolated 2px edge orbit, keyboard focus, pressed feedback
interactionRecipe.motion: one 6s edge orbit per entry; no idle loop; reduced motion removes movement and retains visible focus
interactionRecipe.flow: Do not add card contour fields; preserve the calm card surface and the single default dot-grid scene
interactionRecipe.reading: Dense body, charts and evidence keep stable opaque plates; noninteractive cards never imply whole-card clickability

rules: 只承载高优先级结论与阅读内容
卡内密集信息切换为 SolidPlate

accessibility.role: group, article, or region as content requires
requirements: 可交互整卡必须使用单一明确的链接或按钮
不可只靠悬停呈现关键信息
